what: Bambusa Therapeutics develops long-acting antibody medicines for immune and inflammatory diseases. None are approved for sale yet.
proceeds: It expects about $152.4 million in net proceeds. About $90.0 million is for its lead drug BBT001 and $40.0 million for BBT002. The rest is for two early-stage drugs, equipment, working capital and general costs.
risks: It is an early-stage drug developer with a short history and no approved products, so its future is hard to judge.
It has lost significant money since it began, expects more losses, and may never become profitable.
Even if a drug is approved, doctors and patients may not accept it, and the market may be smaller than expected.
It faces strong competition, and others may develop or sell treatments before it does or do it better.
Raising more money could dilute current shareholders, limit how the company operates, or force it to give up rights to its drugs.
